**A is the correct answer: yes, the employer can enforce the covenant, because the continued employment it gave her for two years after she signed is adequate consideration.** This reverses my earlier answer of D. Although her employment was at will, the employer did not have to keep her on, and courts following the majority rule treat that substantial period of continued employment as enough to support a mid-employment covenant. Option B gives the wrong reason, since modifying a contract generally still needs consideration.

CONFIDENCE: 75
